cfpb.narrative:
XXXX, I have XXXX issues that this complaint is based on. 

XXXX. Poor Service! Chime is a XXXX company who doesn't have its own Banking operation. XXXX  % of their customer service is deliver thru a computer answering machine. If your issue doesn't fit in XXXX of the XXXX choices given it extremely difficult to contact a human operator. You're routinely hung on when you dial XXXX. It has taken me XXXX or XXXX times to evently reach a human operator. 

XXXX. It takes crazy amounts of times to get things done for their customers. 
a. A friend I recommended to them gave up in frustration and decided he wanted his account closed. He requested a check for the money in his account. It took almost XXXX months to receive his money. The gentleman 's name is XXXX XXXX. XXXX - XXXX XXXXXXXX XXXX. On XX/XX/XXXX, I filed a fraud for a complaint for {$64.00} against XXXX XXXX I was told it would take XXXX days to investigate it. 

XXXX. Not enough humans helping Customers. I'm a XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX. I don't need more unnecessary stress. 

XXXX. Untrained rep 's half waiting on customer with the mind set of getting the customers off the phone ASAP. A couple of weeks ago I had a scenario where I thought my Social Security check wasn't deposited around the due date. ( XXXX Wednesday of month ) I eventually got talked to XXXX Chime reps and they told my check hadn't been deposited. So, after contacting Social Security, they assured me my check had been deposited as normal to my checking account used over the last XXXX months. Because of this I called and spoke to XXXX Chime rep who give me the same story. ( No Deposit ) Neither of the XXXX professionals thought to look in my deposit history. If XXXX of those XXXX had taken XXXX seconds to look like I did a week later they would have found out my check had been deposited a week earlier. This is the first time it came that much earlier. I admit to missing it. But the bigger problem is all XXXX Chime reps also missed it as well. 

XXXX. I feel I am being punished for filing, my first complaint. It seems suspect the timing of my fraud filing was on XX/XX/XXXX, then right after the time they should have received my complaint. I received a denial on it. I requested a look at the documentation which was used to deny my claim. To which I haven't received a response. 

Inclosing, I apologize for filing a false claim. I thought I could depend on the information provided by XXXX different rep 's saying the same thing but I was wrong to trust them.
